issue.body:
Conform to Routing V1 HTTP spec: https://specs.ipfs.tech/routing/http-routing-v1/

I'm giving a talk on IPFS Connect about Delegated Routing. It would be useful to have some JavaScript library with the latest. I will definitely need some pointers from TS folks.

    - [x] GET /peers

body: Would you like to send a Pull Request to address this issue? Remember to add unit tests.

FWIW, the issue lives here: https://github.com/fastify/fastify/blob/9b8a7825dc033887d293549e40284284bf27c5a5/lib/reply.js#L167

What we do is build a `Buffer` instance out of the `ArrayBuffer`, which remains at an original size and not the one from the typed array, which sliced a portion of the original byte array.
If we pass the typed array, the size from the typed array prevails.
I have the feeling that is anyway bad to use an ArrayView?!

Hmm, not sure of the decision behind it; but I imagine that it is to avoid duplicating the buffer and then saving memory. However, it is a valid concern, as the `Buffer` itself extends up to the `ArrayView` not the `TypedArray`.

You don't always control the allocation of `Uint8Array`s (or `Buffer`s for that matter), for example if it's done by a third party module they might use an `ArrayBuffer` internally for efficiency and then return a view on that `ArrayBuffer`.

https://github.com/fastify/fastify/blob/9b8a7825dc033887d293549e40284284bf27c5a5/lib/reply.js#L167

Does `payloadToSend` have to be a `Buffer`?  Would a `Uint8Array` suffice?

```js
const payloadToSend = payload instanceof Uint8Array ? payload : Buffer.from(payload.buffer) 
```

This will pass `Buffer`s and `Uint8Array`s through since `Buffer` extends `Uint8Array` since node 4 or something.

If it must be a `Buffer` we can convert `Uint8Array`s to `Buffer`s without copying as:

```js
const payloadToSend = Buffer.isBuffer(payload) ? payload : Buffer.from(payload.buffer, payload.byteOffset, payload.byteLength) 
```
The latter proposal would be perfect.

Just FYI, looking into this, and the latter is causing an error at https://github.com/fastify/fastify/blob/9b8a7825dc033887d293549e40284284bf27c5a5/lib/reply.js#L616-L618 which means we also have to change `typeof payload !== 'string' && !Buffer.isBuffer(payload)` to `typeof payload !== 'string' && !Buffer.isBuffer(payload) && !(payload instanceof Uint8Array)` or similar.

will check if other things break.

issue.title: fix: reply.send supports Uint8Array payload

repository.name: fastify
repository.description: Fast and low overhead web framework, for Node.js

issue.body:
- test: false positive Uint8Array view length
- fix(reply.send): support Uint8Array payloads

This issue fixes https://github.com/fastify/fastify/issues/5118 according to the
agreed upon [comment](https://github.com/fastify/fastify/issues/5118#issuecomment-1778897189).
